component.name: NAM Audio Pipe
component.summary: Low-latency PipeWire standalone host for Neural Amp Modeler

description.p: NAM-Audio-Pipe is an ultra-low latency, real-time standalone PipeWire host application for Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) simulation on Linux, engineered in pure Rust with strict real-time safety.

ul.li: Direct native PipeWire integration (libpipewire-0.3) at low quantum buffer sizes down to 64 samples (1.33 ms).
Embedded NeuralAmpModeler-rs DSP engine supporting WaveNet (A1/A2), LSTM, ConvNet, Linear FIR, and Sequential topologies in standard .nam and binary .namb v2 formats.
Strict real-time safety: zero heap allocations, zero mutex locks, and zero blocking calls on the audio loop.
Integrated CabSim Impulse Response (IR) loader with zero-latency partitioned UPOLS convolution and configurable partition sizes (32–256 samples).
PipeWire SPA latency reporting with live graph feedback and exact sample delay compensation.
Concurrent asynchronous 32-bit float stereo WAV recording powered by Linux io_uring with pre-allocated slot pools, 4 GiB auto-split, and noise-gate trimming.
Half-band polyphase anti-aliasing oversampling (2× and 4×) and adaptive compute auto-slimming under CPU pressure.
Hardware-accelerated SIMD AVX2/FMA baseline vectorization (x86-64-v3) with Profile-Guided Optimization (PGO) and LLVM BOLT code reordering.

screenshot.caption: NAM Audio Pipe interactive terminal status display and PipeWire host monitor

ul.li: Integrated NeuralAmpModeler-rs v2.1.0 core DSP engine with updated linear model prewarm calibration.
Explicit --ir-level-policy cab-sim level mode selection (Preserve, GainMatched, Normalized).
Playback-only --output-limit safety clamp for interactive PipeWire monitoring without altering offline captures.
Validated CLI gain boundary enforcement (--input-gain / --output-gain) and documented DSP scope guarantees.
